@comment: Preflight from an ALLOWLISTED origin. corsPreflightMiddleware (routes.go) runs before routing and answers 204 with the Origin ECHOED — never '*' — alongside credentials:true and Vary:Origin, so a shared cache can never serve one origin's grant to another. http://localhost:3000 is a baked-in dev origin in newCORSOriginAllower, the ONE allowlist this gateway has.

Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization, X-User-Id, X-Org-Id, X-Project-Id, X-Environment, X-Roles, X-User-Email, X-Request-ID, X-Client-ID, X-Requested-With, Accept, Accept-Language
